## Dungeon Chess (Compact Skirmish (10×10))

{{svg:compact-board.svg "Dungeon Chess (Compact Skirmish (10×10)) — starting position"}}

A compact 10×10 skirmish map for faster games. A central water hazard (4×4 pool) divides the battlefield, forcing flanking manoeuvres. Each player deploys in a two-rank zone at their edge of the board.

### Map Features

- **Central pool:** 16 impassable water squares in the centre prevent direct charges
- **Deploy zones:** 2 ranks deep at each board edge (20 squares per player)
- **Open flanks:** The columns around the water pool are the primary engagement corridors

### Differences from Standard

Smaller board and simpler terrain. Games resolve faster with fewer tactical options. No corridors, doors, or elevation. Designed for quick pickup games or teaching the core Dungeon Chess movement and combat rules.
